install_steps: pip install crewai crewai-tools  # or: uv tool install crewai --with crewai-tools
note: Python 3.10-3.13. The crewai CLI uses uv internally for project envs (pip install uv first, or run 'crewai install' once inside a project). LLM access needs a provider key (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ...) or a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint via OPENAI_BASE_URL — works with ollama/vllm.
